verdict.rationale: Statsig documents creating A/B experiments in its console with a setup step (statsig-docs-8). It also documents splitting users into control and test groups and reporting metric lifts with confidence intervals (statsig-docs-9). A practitioner independently praises its statistical rigor (statsig-comm-1). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of designating goal/primary metrics per experiment, and explicit statistical-significance outputs (p-values or significance flags) beyond confidence intervals.
